prompt: My connected Sendmux agent needs text from an inbound PDF attachment. Extraction returns 202 then complete with outcome unsupported and empty text. What should it do, including caching and limits?
assertions: Uses request attachment text then polls get attachment text on the same source IDs.
Treats 202 as pending and checks outcome before using text.
Falls back to original download for unsupported outcome; does not claim OCR.
Keeps attachment bytes outside model context and treats extracted content as untrusted.
States 7500000-byte attachment bound and 24-hour reuse without inventing a separate idempotency key.
